function excludedHost(host) {
  return socialDomainRoots.some((root) => host === root || host.endsWith("." + root));
}

function publisherHost(candidate) {
  return (
    typeof candidate === "string" &&
    /^(?=.{1,150}$)(?:[a-z0-9](?:[a-z0-9-]*[a-z0-9])?\.)+[a-z]{2,63}$/.test(candidate) &&
    !/(?:^|\.)(?:localhost|local|internal|test|onion)$/.test(candidate) &&
    !excludedHost(candidate)
  );
}

function pageBatch(pages, allowedHosts, instruction) {
  if (!Array.isArray(pages) || pages.length < 1 || pages.length > 10)
    throw new Error("Enter one to ten pages.");
  if (typeof instruction !== "string" || !instruction.trim() || instruction.length > 1500)
    throw new Error("Enter screenshot description instructions.");
  const hosts = [
    ...new Set(
      String(allowedHosts)
        .toLowerCase()
        .split(",")
        .map((host) => host.trim())
        .filter(Boolean),
    ),
  ];
  if (!hosts.length || hosts.some((host) => !publisherHost(host)))
    throw new Error("Enter approved public publisher or company hostnames.");
  return pages.map((row, index) => {
    const name = typeof row?.website_name === "string" ? row.website_name.trim() : "";
    const url = typeof row?.url === "string" ? row.url.trim() : "";
    const parsed = /^https:\/\/([a-z0-9.-]+)([/?#][^\s<>"'|\\]*)?$/i.exec(url);
    const allowed =
      parsed && publisherHost(parsed[1].toLowerCase()) && hosts.includes(parsed[1].toLowerCase());
    const page = { index, website_name: name, url };
    if (!name || name.length > 200 || !allowed || url.length > 1900) {
      return { ...page, error: "invalid_page" };
    }
    return {
      ...page,
      instruction,
      request: {
        url,
        full_page: true,
        format: "png",
        save_hashes: true,
        fail_on_4xx: true,
        fail_on_5xx: true,
        block_urls: allowedBlocks,
      },
    };
  });
}

export default ({ pages, allowedHosts, instruction }) => ({
  pages: pageBatch(pages, allowedHosts, instruction),
});
